title: Route Decision Lattice — Q3 Prioritization
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight working doc to converge on which console/tooling routes we keep, which we refactor into a single unified flow, and which we park for Dedicated/Private only. Goal is a minimal, predictable UX surface for 0–2 sprint cut cycles while preserving the telemetry hooks needed for Optimize and Rollouts.

Overview summary:
- Problem: Console has accumulated 6+ route entry points for model selection, routing policy, and fallback configuration. Each route carries duplicated validations, different error surfaces, and inconsistent defaults (leading to support tickets and customer confusion).
- Proposal: Use a decision lattice (matrix) to map routes by primary intent (latency-first, cost-first, regulatory), number of required knobs, and telemetry dependencies. From that lattice derive 3 buckets: keep-as-primary, merge-to-fastpath, and deprioritize-to-dedicated.

Constraints / non-goals:
- Non-goal: Complete UI redesign. This is cut-cycle focused: small, reversible changes that reduce cognitive load and errors.
- Constraint: Must preserve programmatic parity (API + Console) for any primary route we keep.
- Constraint: No DB schema migrations in this cycle. Avoid changes that require long infra lead time.

Decision lattice axes (quick):
- X axis: Primary intent (latency | cost | isolation)
- Y axis: Complexity (0 knobs — simple | 1–3 knobs — medium | >3 knobs — complex)
- Color tag: Telemetry criticality (red = required for Optimize/regression alerts, amber = helpful, green = optional)

Mapping notes (examples):
- "Fast hosted route" (latency, 0–1 knobs, telemetry=red) => keep-as-primary. Minimal inputs: model, request profile. Default intelligent batching enabled.
- "Quant/Custom profile" (cost, 2–4 knobs, telemetry=amber) => merge-to-fastpath with advanced toggle collapsed by default. Expose only when user opts into "cost tuning" mode.
- "Private airgapped deployment" (isolation, 3+ knobs, telemetry=green) => deprioritize-to-dedicated/private docs and link (not shown inline).

Candidate tickets surfaced during grooming (quick list):
- JIRA-CON-3421: unify model selector component across hosted/dedicated. (owner: Liam)
- JIRA-CON-3489: fold quantization profile into advanced toggle; collapse UI by default. (owner: Noor)
- JIRA-CON-3567: remove legacy route "Experimentary-fallback" and migrate prefs to rollout policy. (owner: Diego)
- JIRA-CON-3594: telemetry event parity for Fast hosted route (token-level cost + latency). (owner: Samira)
- JIRA-CON-3610: add in-console hint linking to Private deployment docs for isolation-only flows. (owner: Maya)

Prioritization buckets (Rough):
- A (Sprint 1 cut):
  - CON-3421 unify model selector (blocks several downstream UX bugs)
  - CON-3594 telemetry parity (required for Optimize alerting)
  - CON-3489 quant toggle collapse (large UX win, small code changes)
- B (Sprint 2, conditional):
  - CON-3567 remove legacy route (needs migration plan + release notes)
  - CON-3610 docs/hint linking (low risk)
- C (Park / Dedicated-only):
  - Legacy experimentary route (low usage, high maintenance)
  - Per-region custom routing UI (complex infra dependency)

Wireframe writeups (quick, voice-of-designer notes):
- Top-level: keep a single "Create Route" CTA that prompts primary intent radio (Latency | Cost | Isolation). Radio selection sets a lightweight form scaffold.
- Default collapsed view: show 3 inputs only — name, model, intent. Under the intent area add a subtle inline "Advanced" chevron that expands cost and fallback knobs.
- Quant toggle: visual CTA with pill 'Enable cost tuning' that, when toggled, reveals quant and batching knobs. Default OFF. Tooltip: "Reduces unit cost; may alter model output — recommended for non-critical workloads."
- Telemetry indicator: small dot (green/amber/red) next to route name showing whether route emits Optimize-required events. Hover shows exact metrics emitted.

Acceptance criteria (for A bucket items):
- Unified selector (CON-3421): same component used in 95% of console flows; no regressions in e2e tests; component doc and storybook entry updated.
- Telemetry parity (CON-3594): events emitted for request start, end, token_count, latency_ms; integration test that validates events appear in dev telemetry sandbox.
- Quant toggle collapse (CON-3489): default collapsed state on new route creation; user can opt-in and see immediate preview of unit-cost estimate.

Rollout / mitigation plan:
- Feature flag each change behind a console feature-flag (ff-console-unified-selector, ff-console-quant-collapse). Enable in staging for 48h, then roll to internal dogfood org for 7 days before wide rollout.
- Monitor: error rate for route creation, support tickets mentioning "route confusion", and changes in Optimize alerts.

Telemetry & metrics (what we'll track):
- Route creation success rate (target >98%)
- % of new routes created with Advanced toggles expanded (expect <20% after change)
- Avg time to create route (goal reduce by 30% for simple flows)
- Number of support threads referencing "which route to choose" (reduce)

Dependencies / blockers:
- Infra: telemetry events need new schema mapping for Optimize ingestion (work owned by infra-team, DEP-1104).
- Backend: API contract for model selector needs small change to accept unified model id shape.
- Docs: Private deployment docs need small snippet for UI hint (owner: Docs team)

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we hide cost-estimate numbers for Private deployments (customer legal asked)? (action: Samira to confirm with legal)
- Should we expose a "preview sample" for quantized models in console or only via API? (risk: compute cost)
- Migration: if we remove legacy route, do we auto-migrate user prefs or present a one-click conversion? (UX tradeoffs)

Meeting notes (triage sync 2026-08-14):
- Attendees: Maya, Liam, Noor, Diego, Samira
- Decisions made: go-ahead for A bucket in sprint 1; use FF gating; disable default advanced expansion; add telemetry parity ticket to sprint 1 scope.
- Immediate actions assigned:
  - Liam: PR for unified selector stub + storybook (due 2026-08-18)
  - Noor: implement collapsed advanced toggle (due 2026-08-21)
  - Diego: prepare migration plan draft for legacy route removal (due 2026-08-20)
  - Samira: legal check on Private deployment cost-display (due 2026-08-19)

Next steps / cadence:
- Triage sync weekly (Thurs 11:00 PT) until A bucket shipped.
- Slack channel pinned notes and links.
- Update this doc post-staging run with numbers and any rollback notes.

Notes-to-self / rough ideas (informal):
- Try a small inline A/B: for 10% of new accounts, hide model complexity entirely and surface only "recommended" models (see RED-ux-exp-07). Fast path might produce big uplift in time-to-value.
- Keep wording light: avoid engineering-y terms on first touch. "Latency-first" vs "low-latency" — pick the former in UI copy tests.

References and context links:
- High-level routing strategy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Routing+Strategy
- Previous groom doc: (linked in channel)

Status: draft — sync on 2026-08-18 to lock sprint commitments.
